text:
Aisha: Heads-up: Renewal risk alerts jumped ~12% for Mid-Market this morning around 02:10 UTC. Noticed it in the daily digest.
Tom: I saw the spike. charts show a mass shift in days_since_last_activity buckets.
Diego: could be the ingestion window. We recently switched connector from use_local_time to use_utc (PR by Priya).
Priya: that change was to fix duplicate events across DST boundaries. I tested locally but didn't run full cohort checks.
Aisha: example: acct 900123 shows last_touch 2026-02-26T23:55:00-08:00 in CRM, but in analytics it became 2026-02-26T15:55:00Z which moved it past the 30-day stale threshold.
Tom: ah, so timezone normalization truncated the day offset and bumped many accounts into stale.
Diego: quick query to sample the affected accounts:
```
SELECT account_id, last_touch_crm, last_touch_analytic, days_diff
FROM cs_qa.timezone_audit
WHERE cohort = 'Mid-Market' AND change_ts BETWEEN '2026-02-26 01:00' AND '2026-02-26 03:00';
```
Tom: sampling results: ~22% had last_touch shifted by >=8 hours; ~9% crossed the 30-day boundary.
Priya: re: PR - I changed the connector to cast timestamps with AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' to force consistency. that can shift offsets if original timezone was already labelled with an offset.
Aisha: action plan proposal: 1) pause the new connector mapping (rollback), 2) enqueue a backfill to recompute days_since_last_activity for affected cohorts, 3) add a realtime alert for >5% cohort delta in renewal_risk within 1h.
Diego: +1. also add a lightweight sanity check in CI that runs a small cohort eq to detect timezone deltas >4h.
Priya: on it. will open rollback and backfill tickets and push a hotfix to keep previous casting behavior but with stricter parsing.
cs-bot: :information_source: Deploy event: connector-service v3.2.7 by Priya scheduled rollback at 02:38 UTC.
Tom: I'll run the backfill dry-run and post the delta CSV to the runbook channel.
Aisha: please also hold off on any renewal outreach for Mid-Market until we confirm backfill results so we don't mistakenly contact low-touch customers.
Priya: noted. I will include a list of top 200 affected accounts in the ticket so success can triage outreach hold.
Diego: postmortem notes: add test vectors with mixed timezone offsets, document the expected normalization behavior, and adjust the healthscore thresholding logic to rely on date (Y-M-D) rather than epoch when deciding 30-day staleness, to be more robust to small shifts.
Aisha: thanks. let's reconvene after backfill completes (ETA ~2h). :calendar:
